body.text: Viking Libra, the world's first hydrogen‑powered cruise ship, arrived at the Port of Venice at 16:00 on 27 November 2026.
The ship, built by Fincantieri in Ancona, represents a significant innovation for the cruise sector.

The arrival ceremony was attended by Venice City Council President Matteo Senno and representatives from the Veneto Region, the Autorità di Sistema Portuale del Mare Adriatico Settentrionale, maritime authorities and the Venetian port community.
Viking Libra is equipped with hydrogen‑fuel cells capable of generating up to 6 MW of power, enabling zero‑emission navigation.

why_it_matters.text: The arrival marks a milestone in maritime sustainability, showcasing hydrogen technology in a major tourist hub.
